summary: Independent DAY-shift expectations/execution pass confirms that Earth currently has only one publishable company and the ranking is explicitly unofficial. For GEV, business execution is strong but the equity already prices substantial success: recent market capitalization is roughly $246B-$256B against current revenue/cash-flow scale. That supports keeping Earth Score separate from execution attractiveness and treating valuation as a meaningful gating consideration for new capital. XTND cannot receive an opportunity/execution view until capitalization and runway are normalized.

materialFindings.finding: GEV's current Earth record is high quality but not official: runtime shows one publishable company, GEV Earth Score 81.8, Data Confidence 92.4 and marketValuationOpportunity 56, with current-ranking official=false. No live position in this file should be represented as an official Championship/Contender rank before T0.

Primary Q2 2026 operating guidance supports strong execution—orders $24.2B, revenue $11.1B, adjusted EBITDA margin 11.3%, free cash flow $5.1B and raised guidance—so the valuation caution is not a weak-business call. It is an expectations-versus-price issue.

Market references clustered near a quarter-trillion-dollar valuation immediately before this cycle: StockAnalysis reported approximately $255.68B market cap on September 11, 2026, while CompaniesMarketCap reported approximately $246B around September 10. The spread is tolerable for coarse expectation framing but not precise target math.

At roughly $246B-$256B market capitalization, GEV needs continued high-quality conversion of backlog, margins and capacity expansion to justify further multiple expansion. This is consistent with a strong company / less-obvious entry asymmetry and argues against letting price momentum silently lift Earth quality.

XTND remains execution-unscorable: its S-8 registers substantial equity-plan capacity, while the Chief directive still lacks a reconciled post-close common/pre-funded-warrant denominator and normalized runway. Any per-share target or opportunity score now would fabricate precision.

unknowns: A primary or institution-grade same-timestamp consensus dataset was not available in this pass; analyst target precision and consensus dispersion therefore remain unknown.
Crowding/positioning sufficient for a quantitative crowding penalty was not established and is not inferred from price appreciation alone.
No defensible same-cycle bear/base/bull per-share targets are proposed because terminal multiples and long-range normalized cash-flow assumptions were not independently rebuilt here.
XTND Opportunity/Execution Score, Action State and target zones remain unknown pending capitalization/runway reconciliation.

peerRequests.request: When GEV evidence refreshes, preserve explicit backlog-to-cash conversion assumptions and capacity milestones so future execution scenarios can be tied to observable operating outcomes.
Keep current-ranking official=false semantics visible until deterministic T0 publication; do not allow the single publishable row to render as an official rank.
